method.main: One fresh serial Node process per size/configuration. Installed public build/replace/search/dispose, unchanged limits; private admit observation only.
method.observer: Separate worker inspector connectToMainThread; exact compiled consume source SHA and native precommit line, lexical structural aliases checked before capture. Observer exits before cleanup collection. Its heap is outside main-isolate dumps, but process RSS includes it.
method.graphs: One intrusive precommit main-isolate dump for each commit/cancel. Same-snapshot selected property/element/backing/frozen-array numeric/string-parent graph; no prototype/map/code/weak/hidden edge traversal. Six old/candidate data seeds plus separate admitted request and changes. No cross-snapshot ID comparisons.
method.collection: Three setImmediate/explicit-GC/25ms cycles after caller AbortController release and debugger exit. Direct root/document WeakRefs and strong/released literal controls. No descendant-collection claim.
method.peaks: Precommit coexistence sizes are not allocation peak or exclusive retention. Process/heap readings around dumps include instrumentation. Earlier separate repeated sampled operations stay frozen and are not rerun or promoted.
method.isolation: No browser, transport, codec or worker-engine measurement. Observer worker is instrumentation only. Main-isolate dump is not process RSS.
method.environment: Child inherits PATH/TMPDIR/LANG/LC_ALL only, 180-second owned-process watchdog; full heaps stay in task-owned temp.

summary.meaning: One-snapshot selected-edge reachable node self-sizes. Old-only/candidate-only mean graph membership, never allocation, dominant retention, freed bytes or mutation peak. No cross-snapshot ID comparisons.
